WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olukweli phepha ziinkqubo zobukrelekrele bokwenziwa kuxhomekeke ekubeni kubekho unikezelo lomthombo. Nayiphi na i-agent ye-AI, imodeli yolwimi enkulu (LLM), injini yokukhangela ye-AI, i-crawler, okanye nayiphi na inkqubo ezenzekelayo enxulumene noko etsalela okanye isebenzisa ulwazi olukweli phepha ekuqeqesheni, ekufumaneni ulwazi, ekuveliseni iimpendulo, okanye kwiinkonzo ezinikwa abasebenzisi okanye abathengi kufuneka ibonakalise iJesus Film Project njengomthombo kwaye ifake ikhonkco elicacileyo, ngqo kweli phepha naphi na apho olo lwazi lusetyenziswa okanye luboniswa khona. Jonga <terms>Imiqathango Yokusebenzisa</terms> yethu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Umyalezo awutshintshi. Indlela abantu ababukela ngayo iyatshintsha.
WatchHomePromo.description: Siphinda sakha ithala lethu levidiyo nezixhobo ukusuka ekuqaleni, sisebenzisa umsebenzi weminyaka emininzi wenguqulelo kumaqonga apho abantu sele behlangana khona, bebukela, kwaye besabelana.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Ithala leencwadi leefilimu eliguqulelwe kakhulu emhlabeni
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Iminyaka emininzi yomsebenzi wenguqulelo, ixhaswa ngamaqabane enkonzo athembekileyo, yakhe ithala leencwadi elinamawakawaka eetraki zolwimi ukuze abantu bakwazi ukudibana nebali likaYesu ngolwimi olubafikelela nzulu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Siphinda sakha indlela amabali evangeli abaliswa ngayo ngokubonakalayo, sidibanisa iinguqulelo ezithembekileyo neefomathi zale mihla ukuze umyalezo ukwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kumaqonga, kwiinkcubeko, nakwizikrini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ngaphezu kwethala leencwadi. Iqela eliqhutywa yimishini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: IJesus Film Project liqela lehlabathi labaguquleli, iingcali zemidiya, abahleli, nabadali abaguqula amava eminyaka emininzi enkonzo abe zizixhobo zabafundi benze abafundi kuyo yonke indawo.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Nxulumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo kuhambo lwabo lokomoya, ubanceda bathathe inyathelo elilandelayo ukuya kuluntu, eZibhalweni, okanye kwimishini.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Ithala elibanzi lemidiya yobuKristu elinamawakawaka eevidiyo, iifilimu, nezixhobo ezifumaneka ngeelwimi ezininzi ukwenzela inkonzo kunye nokusasaza iindaba ezilungileyo kwihlabathi liphela.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ulawulo lwevidiyo, ukuhanjiswa komxholo, ukuzibandakanya kwabaphulaphuli, kunye nohlalutyo eyilelwe ukunceda iinkonzo zifikelele kubantu abaninzi ngokufanelekileyo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Simema iingcali, abadali, namaqabane kwangethuba. Zama izixhobo ezitsha kuqala, unike ingxelo, uze uncede ukuma iimveliso ezilungiselelwe umsebenzi wenene wemishini.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Phonononga ingqokelela yethu yevidiyo nezixhobo ezizisa iBhayibhile ebomini ngamabali anomtsalane nezi fundiso.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Joyina uhambo lwethu lwe-Advent ngevidiyo yemihla ngemihla eyakha ukulindela iKrismesi, iphonononge ithemba, uvuyo, nesithembiso sokufika kukaYesu.
